source.title: WCA Regulations — February 2023: Now in Effect
source.content: New WCA [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and [Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html) are in effect as of February 1, 2023. Please see the [original announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-february-2023) for details.

translation.title: 2023 年 2 月版 WCA 规则现已生效
translation.content: 新版《[WCA 规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)》和《[指南](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html)》已于 2023 年 2 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅[原公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-february-2023)。
translation.revisionReason: 完成当前版本独立审校；正文未改。
